claim: DMZ early access for digital pre-orders started October 20, 2026
quote: starting on Tuesday October 20, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 can gain Early Access to all of DMZ
source: Call of Duty Blog: DMZ Deep Dive, Part 2 (Call of Duty Staff)

claim: Modern Warfare 4 went live worldwide on October 23, 2026
quote: Modern Warfare 4 is now live worldwide!
source: Call of Duty Blog: Modern Warfare 4 is Live Worldwide (Call of Duty Staff)
Call of Duty Blog: Warzone Season 1, Everything You Need to Know (Call of Duty Staff)

claim: Season 1 brings a new area and bosses to DMZ
quote: players will get their hands on new Multiplayer maps and modes, a new area, bosses, and other bonus content in DMZ
source: Call of Duty Blog: Warzone Season 1, Everything You Need to Know (Call of Duty Staff)

claim: Official description of DMZ: players hope to extract with their rewards
quote: players loot, complete objectives, fight both enemies and rival Operators, and hope to extract with their rewards
source: Call of Duty Blog: DMZ Deep Dive, Part 1, Hajin (Call of Duty Staff)

claim: Exfil: call in the helicopter then hold the site until it arrives
quote: Call in the Twin Heli Exfil helicopter, then hold the site until it arrives as enemy pressure intensifies.
source: Call of Duty Blog: DMZ Deep Dive, Part 1, Hajin (Call of Duty Staff)

claim: Backpack items outside a Secure Slot are lost if you fail to exfil
quote: anything not placed in a Secure Slot is lost if you fail to Exfil
source: Call of Duty Blog: DMZ Deep Dive, Part 2, FOB Full Intel Guide (Call of Duty Staff)

claim: BlackCell Challenge Two: 100 Points needed; one successful DMZ Exfil is worth 20 Points
quote: Criteria: Obtain 100 Points. MP: 1 Match Win = 10 Points DMZ: 1 successful Exfil = 20 Points
source: Call of Duty Blog: Season 1 Battle Pass, BlackCell and Store Bundles (Call of Duty Staff)

claim: These are BlackCell challenges that unlock extra Operator Skins and M4 Blueprints
quote: Expand your BlackCell Agent roster and Blueprint collection by completing in-game challenges to unlock two additional XERO Operator Skins and two additional M4 Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprints.
source: Call of Duty Blog: Season 1 Battle Pass, BlackCell and Store Bundles (Call of Duty Staff)
